book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowon wɑɑsu

Ye tem yɛ̃ro Tiberi kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu win bɑndu sɔɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ, Pɔnsu Pilɑtiwɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yudeɑn tem yɛ̃ro, mɑ Herodu u sɑ̃ɑ Gɑlilen wiruɡii, mɑ Filipu win wɔnɔ u sɑ̃ɑ Iture kɑ Tɑkonitin wiruɡii, mɑ Lisɑniɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Abilɛnin wiruɡii.
Yɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Ani kɑ Kɑifɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobun wɑɑti. Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ Yohɑnu Sɑkɑrin bii ɡɑri kuɑ ɡbɑburɔ.
Mɑ u dɑ Yuudɛnin bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kpuro u kpɑrɑmɔ u mɔ̀, bu ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsio bu bɑtɛmu ko, kpɑ Gusunɔ u bu ben torɑnu suuru kuɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ ye Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Esɑi u yoruɑ win tirerɔ yɑ koorɑ ye u nɛɛ,

content.text: “ɡoo u ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ ɡbɑburɔ u mɔ̀, i Yinnin swɑɑ sɔnwɔ.
Kpɑ i n ye nɔɔ nɛrɑsiɑmɔ yu dɛndɑ.
i mɑɑ yen ɡuunu kpuron ɡunum kɑwo
kpɑ i yen ɡunɡunu nɔɔ nɛrɑsiɑ nu ko tem tɛɛrɑ,
kpɑ i yen mi n kɔ̃kure kpuro dɛmiɑ,
kpɑ i yen wɔrusu kpuro kɔre.
Tɔmbu kpurowɑ bɑ koo Gusunɔn fɑɑbɑ wɑ.”

content: Tɔn wɔrusu su dɑɑmɔ win mi u kɑ bu bɑtɛmu ko. Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ wɑɑ ɡɔsɔnun bweseru, wɑrɑ bɛɛ kirɔ kuɑ i kɑ mɔru ye yɑ sisi suuri.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i koowo ye yɑ koo bɛɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑbu sɔ̃ɔsi, kpɑ i ku ɡere bɛɛn tii sɔɔ mɑ Aburɑhɑmuwɑ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑ. Domi nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ Gusunɔ u koo kpĩ u Aburɑhɑmu bibu seeyɑ sɑɑ kpee nini sɔɔn di.
Bɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ sue kɔ bu kɑ dɑ̃nu bɔɔri nin nuurun di. Yen sɔ̃, dɑ̃ru bɑɑtere te tɑ ǹ bii ɡeenu mɑrumɔ, bɑ koo tu burɑwɑ bu dɔ̃ɔ kpɛ̃ɛ.
Mɑ tɔn wɔrusu nùn bikiɑmɔ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑmɔnɑ be, bɑ koo ko.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wi u yɑbenu yiru mɔ u teeru ɡoo wɛ̃ɛyɔ wi u kun mɔ, mɛyɑ mɑɑ wi u dĩɑnu mɔ, u kɑ ɡɑbu bɔnu koowo.
Gbere mwɑɔbɑ mɑɑ dɑ u kɑ bu bɑtɛmu ko, mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni, mbɑ sɑ ko ko.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ku rɑ mwɛ n kere ye bɑ bɛɛ yiire.
Tɑbu kowobu ɡɑbɑ mɑɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛ mɑɑ ni, mbɑ sɑ ko ko. Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ku rɑ ɡoo ɡobi mwɑɑri kɑ dɑm, i ku mɑɑ ɡoo ɡɑri mɑni, kpɑ i ku rɑ bɛɛn kɔsiɑru ɡɛm.
Tɔn be, bɑ swɑɑ dɑki mɑ be kpuro bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, Yohɑnu sɑ̃ɑwɑ Kirisi wi?
Ye Yohɑnu u nuɑ mɛ, u be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛ nɑ bɛɛ bɑtɛmu mɔ̀ kɑ nim, ɑdɑmɑ wi u mɑn dɑm kere u sisi. Nɑ ǹ turɑ n win bɑrɑnun wɛ̃ɛ kusiɑ. Wiyɑ u koo bɛɛ bɑtɛmu ko kɑ Hunde Dɛɛro kɑ dɔ̃ɔ.
U sɑrɑtiɑ nɛni win nɔmɑɔ, u kɑ win ɑlikɑmɑ sɑrɑ, kpɑ u ye doke birɑru sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ sɑko si su tie u koo su doke dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi.
Kɑ mɑɑ ɡɑri dɑbinu ɡɑnɑ Yohɑnu u tɔmbu lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑn wɑɑsu kuɑmmɛ.
Adɑmɑ u Herodu wiruɡii wi ɡerusi Herodiɑ, win wɔnɔ Filipun kurɔn sɔ̃, kɑ dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ kpuro ye u rɑɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ Herodu u kpɑm dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye sɔɔ dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ sosi, u derɑ bɑ Yohɑnu pirisɔm doke.
Yesun bɑtɛmu
Ye bɑ tɔmbu kpuro bɑtɛmu kuɑ, bɑ mɑɑ Yesu bɑtɛmu kuɑ. Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ mɑ wɔllɑ wukiɑrɑ,
mɑ Hunde Dɛɛro u sɑrɑmɑ win wɔllɔ kɑ wɑsi ɡɛɛ nɡe kpɑruko. Mɑ nɔɔ ɡɑɡɑ nɔɔrɑ sɑɑ wɔllun di ɡɑ nɛɛ, wunɑ nɛn bii kĩnɑsi, wì sɔɔ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru dobu kpuro wɑ̃ɑ.
Yesun sikɑdobɑ
Yesu u wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑn sɑkɑ turɑ u sere win sɔmburu toruɑ. Bɑ tɑmɑɑ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yosɛfun bii. Yosɛfun bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Heli
kɑ Mɑtɑti kɑ Lefi kɑ Mɛliki kɑ Yɑnɑi kɑ Yosɛfu,
kɑ Mɑtɑtiɑ kɑ Amɔsi, kɑ Nɑhumu kɑ Esili kɑ Nɑɡɑ,
kɑ Mɑɑtu kɑ Mɑtɑtiɑ kɑ Semɛni kɑ Yosɛki kɑ Yodɑ,
kɑ Yoɑnɑni kɑ Lesɑ kɑ Sorobɑbɛli kɑ Sɑlɑtiɛli kɑ Nɛri,
kɑ Mɛliki kɑ Adi kɑ Kosɑmu kɑ Elimɑdɑmu kɑ Eri,
kɑ Yosue kɑ Eliseri kɑ Yorimu kɑ Mɑtɑti kɑ Lefi,
kɑ Simɛɔ kɑ Yudɑ kɑ Yosɛfu kɑ Yonɑmu kɑ Eliɑkimu,
kɑ Mɛleɑ kɑ Mɛnɑ kɑ Mɑtɑtɑ kɑ Nɑtɑni kɑ Dɑfidi,
kɑ Isɑi kɑ Yobɛdi kɑ Boɑsi kɑ Sɑlɑ kɑ Nɑsoni
kɑ Aminɑdɑbu kɑ Adimi kɑ Arɑni kɑ Esiromu kɑ Fɑrɛsi kɑ Yudɑ,
kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Isɑki kɑ Aburɑhɑmu kɑ Terɑ kɑ Nɑkoru,
kɑ Seruku kɑ Rɑɡɑ kɑ Fɑlɛki kɑ Ebɛɛ kɑ Sɑlɑ,
kɑ Kɑinɑmu kɑ Aɑfɑsɑdi kɑ Sɛmu kɑ Nɔwɛ kɑ Lɑmɛki,
kɑ Mɑtusɑlɑ kɑ Enɔku kɑ Yɑrɛdi kɑ Mɑleleli kɑ Kɑinɑni,
kɑ Enɔsi kɑ Sɛti kɑ Adɑmu kɑ Gusunɔ.
